children: On 21 Nov 2026, POSCO International and LG CNS completed a trade receivables pilot on Injective. The companies used tokens to represent trade receivables, the payments owed to them by their customers. The pilot gave the trading partners involved a shared record on the blockchain.
For INJ, the pilot supports the case for the token as a way to invest in institutional tokenization. It shows companies using Injective to record claims for payment from their trade activity.
2027 is when tokenization goes to the next level. Injective is ready today.
POSCO International and LG CNS just completed a pilot on Injective that tokenized their trade receivables. Every counterparty, one shared onchain record, billions in value.

title: Injective: POSCO International and LG CNS Complete Trade Receivables Pilot - 21 Nov 2026
